templateName: Abused TLDs - URLs .zip/.mov (Aspendora CIPP-30, HIGH false-positive risk)
description: Blocks links under .zip and .mov. HIGH false-positive risk: plain-text file names such as 'invoice.zip' or 'clip.mov' in a message body can be read as links and quarantine the message. Microsoft's URL syntax also disallows file extensions, so these entries may be refused - test in one tenant first. Aspendora fork addition (Vikunja CIPP-30).
